question: A solid hemisphere of radius 8 cm is melted into N identical cone whose radius is 4 cm and height is 2 cm. Then, what is the value of N?
solution:
Given:

Radius of hemisphere = 8 cm

Radius of cone = 4 cm

Height of cone = 2 cm

Concept used:

Volume of hemisphere = (2/3) × πr³

Volume of cone = (1/3) πR²h

Calculation:

The volume of the hemisphere = N × Volume of the cone

⇒ (2/3) × π (8)³ = N × (1/3) × π (4)² × 2

⇒ (2 × 512) = 32N

⇒ N = 32

∴ The value of N is 32.
